answer: Locks are entered in dune, expire in vine, and atlas lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 76 aliases thus needs 113 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1640 identities would post 797 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
